post.description:
RETIRED as a grant (founder, 2026-09-17: "remove the cohort grant
access. they would have to subscribe to get access or try for free for
14 days after"). The Registration app still calls this on every paid
cohort transition (Seam III), so it keeps answering 201 and still
creates or links the account — but grants NOTHING. The account is owed
the ordinary 14-day trial, started the first time the person signs in
(`auth.start_trial_if_owed`), and must subscribe after it. The 327
grants that existed were ended by scripts/retire_cohort_grants.py.

End a grant now (a refunded or cancelled registration). Leaves any
subscription or trial untouched — only the grant is withdrawn.
